zh.title: 美國眾議院報告呼籲研究海軍飛行員腦部受傷風險
zh.summary: 眾院監督報告建議長期追蹤艦載起降對飛行員腦部影響；海軍未充分調查腦傷與心理健康關聯
body: 美國眾議院監督暨政府改革委員會軍事與外交事務小組委員會於2026年9月8日發布員工報告，呼籲進行長期研究，以瞭解反覆的航空母艦起飛、降落與機動動作所產生的強大物理力量，是否會在海軍飛行員職業生涯中對其大腦造成損傷。
報告指出，委員會共和黨領袖、主席詹姆斯·科默與小組主席威廉·蒂蒙斯表示，海軍未充分調查腦部受傷與其飛行員心理健康問題及自殺之間的潛在關聯。現行醫療程序著重於識別特定傷害，可能遺漏逐漸發展的損傷；且擔心喪失飛行資格或損害職業生涯，會阻礙飛行員尋求治療。
2026年4月一項針對超過8,500名現役飛行員的研究發現，沒有明確證據顯示戰鬥與攻擊機機組人員比直升機、監偵或運輸機機組更容易被診斷出偏頭痛、輕度創傷性腦部受傷或記憶與思維問題。研究者承認，因健康問題無法繼續飛行而離隊的飛行員可能未納入研究，且缺乏個人總飛行時數資料，加上不願回報症狀可能影響結果。
該29頁報告引用海軍一項為期12年、成本約390萬美元的健康研究提案，並提及「奧丁之眼」計畫，該計畫檢測特種作戰人員及少數飛行員的大腦功能，但海軍向調查人員表示這並非正式研究計畫。
小組委員會建議國會指示五角大廈設立專責飛行員腦部健康計畫，並修訂阻礙治療的醫療政策，追蹤飛行員是否因執勤產生健康問題，並釐清其在繼續服役期間接受心理醫療的條件。報告強調，這些建議屬於對國會的推薦，而非宣布新研究已獲得撥款或啟動。

en.title: US House report calls for long-term study of brain injury risks in Navy pilots from carrier operations
en.summary: House oversight panel urges study on carrier launch brain effects; Navy links to suicides unexamined
body: The US House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform's Subcommittee on Military and Foreign Affairs published a staff report on September 8, 2026, calling for a long-term study of whether repeated aircraft carrier launches, landings and maneuvers that place intense physical forces on the body can damage Navy pilots' brains over the course of their careers.

Republican leaders of the committee, Chairman James Comer of Kentucky and Subcommittee Chairman William Timmons of South Carolina, said the Navy had not adequately investigated possible links between brain injuries and mental health problems and suicides among its aviators. Existing medical procedures focus on identifying specific injuries and may miss damage that develops gradually, and fear of losing flying privileges or harming careers can discourage aviators from seeking treatment.

An April 2026 study of more than 8,500 active-duty aviators found no clear evidence that fighter and attack jet crews were more likely than helicopter, surveillance or transport crews to have diagnosed migraines, mild traumatic brain injuries, or problems with memory or thinking. The researchers acknowledged that aviators who had already left because of health problems preventing them from continuing to fly could be missing from the study, and that they lacked individual pilots' total flying hours and noted reluctance to report symptoms could affect findings.

The 29-page House report cites a Navy proposal for a 12-year health study costing approximately $3.9 million, plus additional funding for longer follow-up. It also describes Project Odin's Eye, a program that checks brain function in special operations personnel and a small number of aviators; the Navy told investigators it was not a formal research program.

Alongside the proposed study, the subcommittee wants Congress to direct the Pentagon to establish a dedicated aviator brain-health program and revise medical policies that discourage treatment. The recommendations call for tracking whether aviators develop health problems related to their flying and making it clearer when they can receive mental healthcare while continuing to serve. The proposals are recommendations to Congress, rather than an announcement that a new study has been funded or begun.

zh.title: 波音收購Spirit成本超出預期 承接客戶合約估增4.55億美元
zh.summary: 波音收購Spirit成本增至15.2億美元；民航部門預計延至2027年獲利。
body: 波音（Boeing）收購重要供應商 Spirit AeroSystems 的成本已被證實超出最初預期。根據波音提交的一份申報文件，該製造商目前估計，從 Spirit 承接的客戶合約履行成本將比原先計算的高出 4.55 億美元。此一調整使這些合約的預估財務負擔達到 15.2 億美元，相較於 2025 年 12 月底（即收購完成後不久）的估算值，增幅達百分之 43 左右。
這項價值約 84 億美元的收購案於 2025 年 12 月 8 日完成，將 737 客機機身生產，以及 767、777 和 787 機型的重大結構件製造，重新納入波音的直接控制之下。此交易同時讓約 1.5 萬名員工加入波音。波音當時表示，將製造商與其關鍵供應商置於同一管理層之下，將有助於提高品質並穩定生產。
不斷增加的收購支出已對波音的財務展望造成影響。2026 年 3 月 17 日，波音財務長 Jay Malave 曾警告，高於預期的成本已將民用飛機部門預計恢復盈利的時間推遲至 2027 年，比原先預期的時間晚了一年。Malave 在一次投資者會議上指出，在交易實際完成前無法獲得所有完整資訊，並將此財務影響描述為短期阻力。
這些財務調整正值波音提高飛機交付量之際。2026 年 9 月 8 日公布的數據顯示，波音在 2026 年前八個月共交付了 418 架飛機，高於去年同期的 385 架。然而，2026 年 8 月的單月交付量自 7 月的 53 架降至 51 架，其中 787 機型的交付量也從 10 架減少至 4 架。

波音並未透露是哪些特定客戶或飛機項目導致了這筆 4.55 億美元的成本增加，並表示其評估仍屬初步階段。與此同時，Spirit 的其他業務已被拆分或繼續為外部客戶服務。空中巴士（Airbus）在 2025 年 12 月交易結束時接管了與其自身飛機相關的業務，而 Spirit 的國防部門則維持獨立營運，持續為諾斯洛普·格魯曼（Northrop Grumman）的 B-21 轟炸機和塞考斯基（Sikorsky）的 CH-53K 直升機提供結構件。其更廣泛的客戶群還包括公務機製造商龐巴迪（Bombardier）和引擎製造商勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）。

en.title: Boeing’s Spirit AeroSystems Takeover Costs Rise by $455 Million Above Estimates
en.summary: Boeing expects inherited customer deals to cost $1.52 billion; commercial division profitability is delayed to 2027.
body: Boeing’s acquisition of major supplier Spirit AeroSystems has proven more expensive than initially projected. According to a Boeing regulatory filing, the manufacturer now estimates that customer contracts inherited from Spirit will cost $455 million more to fulfill than first calculated. This adjustment brings the total estimated burden of those agreements to $1.52 billion, representing a 43% increase over the estimate compiled in late December 2025, shortly after the acquisition was finalized.

The transaction, valued at approximately $8.4 billion, was completed on December 8, 2025. It integrated Spirit’s production lines for 737 fuselages along with major structural components for the 767, 777, and 787 programs back under Boeing's direct management. The acquisition also brought approximately 15,000 employees into Boeing. At the time, Boeing stated that uniting the companies under a single management structure would help stabilize production and improve manufacturing quality.

The rising acquisition costs have already impacted Boeing's financial outlook. On March 17, 2026, Chief Financial Officer Jay Malave cautioned that integration expenses had delayed the commercial aircraft division's expected return to profitability to 2027, which is one year later than previously forecast. Malave noted at an investor conference that companies do not obtain full access to all detailed financial information until transactions officially close, describing the impact as a short-term headwind.

These financial adjustments are occurring as Boeing increases its overall delivery output. Data released on September 8, 2026, showed that Boeing delivered 418 aircraft during the first eight months of 2026, up from 385 aircraft delivered during the same period in 2025. However, deliveries in August 2026 slipped to 51 from the 53 aircraft delivered in July, with 787 Dreamliner handovers dropping from ten in July to four in August.

Boeing has not disclosed which specific customers or aircraft programs contributed to the $455 million cost increase, stating that its assessment remains preliminary. Meanwhile, other parts of Spirit's original business have been divided or continue to serve external clients. Airbus took over operations related to its own aircraft programs when the transactions closed in December 2025, while Spirit's independent defense segment continues to supply structures for Northrop Grumman's B-21 bomber and Sikorsky's CH-53K helicopter. Other commercial customers include Bombardier and Rolls-Royce.

zh.title: 雪梨機場（SYD）宣布埃及航空2027年起開航開羅新航線
zh.summary: 埃及航空規劃2027年起開航開羅─新加坡─雪梨航線
body: 雪梨金斯福德史密斯機場（SYD）宣布，埃及航空（EgyptAir）將加入其航空網絡，並規劃自2027年起開設一條連結開羅、新加坡與雪梨的新航線。
這條航線於2026年9月9日在埃及的El Alamein航空展期間宣布，將是雪梨與開羅之間的首條直飛航線，惟尚須獲得監管核准。
機場方面表示，這項新增使雪梨機場的航空公司總數達到紀錄性的54家，強化了其作為澳洲最大國際門戶的地位，並建立了澳洲與埃及之間的新空中連結。
雪梨機場執行長Scott Charlton表示，這項服務為旅客提供更多選擇，並開啟澳洲、埃及及更廣泛區域之間觀光、貿易與文化交流的新機會。
埃及航空董事長兼執行長機長Ahmed Adel表示，與雪梨機場的合作是擴大該航國際網絡的重要一步。

en.title: Sydney Airport (SYD) welcomes EgyptAir; new Cairo-Singapore-Sydney service planned from 2027
en.summary: EgyptAir plans Cairo-Singapore-Sydney flights from 2027; first direct Australia-Egypt link
body: Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport (SYD) announced that EgyptAir will join its airline network, with the Egyptian flag carrier planning to launch a service connecting Cairo, Singapore and Sydney from 2027.
The route, announced on September 9, 2026, during the El Alamein Air Show in Egypt, is expected to mark the first direct link between Sydney and Cairo, subject to regulatory approvals.
The addition brings Sydney Airport's total to a record 54 airlines, reinforcing its position as Australia's largest international gateway and creating a new air link between Australia and Egypt.

Sydney Airport CEO Scott Charlton said the service delivers greater choice for passengers and unlocks opportunities for tourism, trade and cultural exchange between Australia, Egypt and the region. EgyptAir Chairman and CEO Captain Ahmed Abdel Rahman said the partnership marks an important step in expanding the airline's international network.
